cases.words: Count the distribution days in the last 25 bars, where a distribution day is a close down at least 0.2 percent from the prior close on higher volume than the prior bar, and stop counting a distribution day once a later close has risen 5 percent above that day's close

history.reason: written from the request's words before the answer was read

script.pine:
//@version=5
indicator("Distribution day count", overlay=false)
win       = input.int(25, "Window (bars)", minval=1, maxval=200)
dropPct   = input.float(0.2, "Minimum close drop (%)", minval=0.0, step=0.1)
expirePct = input.float(5.0, "Stop counting a day after a rise of (%)", minval=0.1, step=0.5)
// a distribution day: a close down at least dropPct percent from the prior close, on more volume than the prior bar
isDist = close <= close[1] * (1 - dropPct / 100) and volume > volume[1]
// the days still counting: a day drops out once any LATER close is expirePct percent above its close
count = 0
for i = 0 to win - 1
    if isDist[i]
        expired = false
        if i > 0
            for j = 0 to i - 1
                if close[j] >= close[i] * (1 + expirePct / 100)
                    expired := true
        if not expired
            count += 1
plot(count, "Distribution days", color=color.red, style=plot.style_stepline)

cases.words: Track a rally attempt. It starts on the first bar that closes above the prior close while the close is at least 5 percent below the highest close of the last 60 bars. It ends when a later bar's low is below the low of the bar it started on. Show the bars that are the fourth bar or later of a live attempt, counting the start as the first, and that close at least 1.25 percent above the prior close on higher volume than the prior bar

history.reason: written from the request's words before the answer was read

script.pine:
//@version=5
indicator("Rally attempt follow-through", overlay=true)
lookback    = input.int(60, "Highest-close lookback (bars)", minval=2)
drawdownPct = input.float(5.0, "Percent below the highest close", minval=0.0, step=0.25)
minDay      = input.int(4, "Earliest bar of the attempt", minval=1)
gainPct     = input.float(1.25, "Minimum gain on the bar (%)", minval=0.0, step=0.05)
// at least drawdownPct percent below the highest close of the last `lookback` bars (this bar included)
hiClose = ta.highest(close, lookback)
inCorrection = close <= hiClose * (1 - drawdownPct / 100)
// ONE attempt at a time, kept across bars: whether it is live, which bar of it this is, and the low it started on
var bool  active   = false
var int   dayCount = 0
var float startLow = na
if active
    // the attempt ends when a later bar's low is below the low of the bar it started on
    if low < startLow
        active := false
        dayCount := 0
        startLow := na
    else
        dayCount += 1
// it starts on a bar that closes above the prior close while in the correction (a new one may start on the bar the old one ended)
if not active and close > close[1] and inCorrection
    active := true
    dayCount := 1
    startLow := low
// the signal: bar minDay or later of a live attempt, up at least gainPct percent on more volume than the prior bar
followThrough = active and dayCount >= minDay and close >= close[1] * (1 + gainPct / 100) and volume > volume[1]
plotshape(followThrough, "Follow-through bar", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.green, size=size.small)

cases.words: Plot the 14 day ATR as a percent of the close, and show its latest value in a table in the top right corner

history.reason: written from the request's words before the answer was read

script.pine:
//@version=5
indicator("ATR % of close", overlay=false)

len = input.int(14, "ATR length", minval=1)
showPct = input.bool(true, "Show value in table")

// ATR by Wilder's definition: RMA of True Range
atrVal = ta.rma(ta.tr, len)
atrPct = atrVal / close * 100

plot(atrPct, "ATR % of close", color=color.teal, linewidth=2)
plot(ta.sma(atrPct, len), "Average of ATR %", color=color.orange)

var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 3, border_width=1)
if showPct
    table.cell(t, 0, 0, "ATR(" + str.tostring(len) + ")", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    table.cell(t, 1, 0, str.tostring(atrVal, "#.####"), text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 1, "ATR %", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    table.cell(t, 1, 1, str.tostring(atrPct, "#.##") + "%", text_color=color.white)
    table.cell(t, 0, 2, "Close", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
    table.cell(t, 1, 2, str.tostring(close, "#.####"), text_color=color.white)

cases.words: Count the distribution days in the last 25 bars, where a distribution day is a close down at least 0.2 percent from the prior close on higher volume than the prior bar. Plot the count and show it in a status table that says Under pressure when the count is 5 or more and Normal otherwise

history.reason: written from the request's words before the answer was read

script.pine:
//@version=5
indicator("Distribution Day Count", overlay=false)

lookback = input.int(25, "Lookback bars", minval=1)
dropPct  = input.float(0.2, "Minimum close drop (%)", minval=0.0, step=0.1)
threshold = input.int(5, "Pressure threshold (days)", minval=1)

// A distribution day: close down at least dropPct% from the prior close,
// on volume higher than the prior bar's volume.
pctChange = (close - close[1]) / close[1] * 100
isDist = pctChange <= -dropPct and volume > volume[1]

int ddCount = 0
for i = 0 to lookback - 1
    ddCount += isDist[i] ? 1 : 0

underPressure = ddCount >= threshold

plot(ddCount, "Distribution days", color=color.red, style=plot.style_columns)
plot(threshold, "Threshold", color=color.gray)

var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 2, border_width=1)
table.cell(t, 0, 0, "Distribution days", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
table.cell(t, 1, 0, str.tostring(ddCount), text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 40))
table.cell(t, 0, 1, "Status", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
table.cell(t, 1, 1, underPressure ? "Under pressure" : "Normal", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=underPressure ? color.red : color.green)

cases.words: Plot the percent the close is above its 10 day, 21 day and 50 day simple moving averages as three lines, and show the three latest values in a table with one row each

history.reason: written from the request's words before the answer was read

script.pine:
//@version=5
indicator("% above 10/21/50 SMA", overlay=false)

src = input.source(close, "Source")
len1 = input.int(10, "Fast SMA length", minval=1)
len2 = input.int(21, "Mid SMA length", minval=1)
len3 = input.int(50, "Slow SMA length", minval=1)

sma1 = ta.sma(src, len1)
sma2 = ta.sma(src, len2)
sma3 = ta.sma(src, len3)

pct1 = (src - sma1) / sma1 * 100
pct2 = (src - sma2) / sma2 * 100
pct3 = (src - sma3) / sma3 * 100

plot(pct1, "% above fast SMA", color=color.green, linewidth=2)
plot(pct2, "% above mid SMA", color=color.orange, linewidth=2)
plot(pct3, "% above slow SMA", color=color.red, linewidth=2)
plot(0, "Zero", color=color.gray)

var table t = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 4, border_width=1)
table.cell(t, 0, 0, "SMA", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
table.cell(t, 1, 0, "% from close", text_color=color.white, bgcolor=color.gray)
table.cell(t, 0, 1, str.tostring(len1) + " day", text_color=color.white)
table.cell(t, 1, 1, str.tostring(pct1, "#.##") + "%", text_color=pct1 >= 0 ? color.lime : color.red)
table.cell(t, 0, 2, str.tostring(len2) + " day", text_color=color.white)
table.cell(t, 1, 2, str.tostring(pct2, "#.##") + "%", text_color=pct2 >= 0 ? color.lime : color.red)
table.cell(t, 0, 3, str.tostring(len3) + " day", text_color=color.white)
